title: TypeScript conformance
summary: Agents writing, reviewing, or testing durable repository TypeScript and TSX MUST apply the TypeScript style and Node.js guidance this policy references together with the configured formatter.
instructions: Agents writing, reviewing, or testing TypeScript MUST read the complete TypeScript and Node.js guidance this policy references, and MUST apply it before completion.
Agents MUST run the configured formatter and type checker before completion and MUST treat formatter output as authoritative.

Workflow-local automation under runtime/logs/workflows/<run-id>/scripts/ MAY be throwaway and need not conform to the repository TypeScript style guidance unless it is promoted into durable repository code.
Agents MUST NOT reconstruct or separately load formatter-owned appendix rules during ordinary implementation or review unless they are changing formatter configuration or integration.

guidance_sources.read_trigger: Read this guidance before you write, review, or test TypeScript or TSX.
Read this guidance before you write, review, or test TypeScript, TSX, or Node.js code.
